result.summary: Found 1 visually broken element: an invalid '€NaN' delivery price is displayed for Smash Bros Burgers in the 'Fastest near you' row.

issues.description: The delivery fee under 'Smash Bros Burgers' displays as '€NaN delivery' instead of a valid price.
issues.suggestion: Fix the price formatting / data source to show a valid delivery fee or hide the fee line when unavailable, avoiding display of 'NaN' to users.
